mapper.select: SELECT first_bbk_id AS bbk_id, MIN(NULLIF(first_bbk_nm, '')) AS bbk_name, org_id, MIN(NULLIF(org_nm, '')) AS org_name FROM rm_jkh_user_info WHERE first_bbk_id IS NOT NULL AND first_bbk_id != '' GROUP BY first_bbk_id, org_id ORDER BY first_bbk_id, org_id
SELECT DISTINCT pst_lvl FROM rm_jkh_user_info WHERE pst_lvl IS NOT NULL AND pst_lvl != '' ORDER BY pst_lvl
SELECT skill_id AS id, MIN(NULLIF(skill_name, '')) AS name FROM swe_marketplace_skills WHERE source_id = 'RMASSIST' AND skill_id IS NOT NULL AND skill_id != '' GROUP BY skill_id ORDER BY skill_id

SELECT k.skill_id AS id, MIN(NULLIF(k.skill_name, '')) AS name FROM swe_marketplace_skills k JOIN swe_cron_jobs j ON j.skill_ids = k.skill_id WHERE k.source_id = 'RMASSIST' AND k.skill_id IS NOT NULL AND k.skill_id != '' AND j.source_id = 'RMASSIST' AND j.status != 'deleted' AND
(j.plan_id = #{r.planId} AND j.skill_ids = #{r.skillId})
GROUP BY k.skill_id ORDER BY k.skill_id

SELECT p.id, p.name, CASE WHEN p.source_label = '分行中台' THEN '分行关注' ELSE p.source_label END AS source, p.sap_id AS owner_id, p.creator_name AS owner_name, u.pst_lvl AS owner_level, p.period_start, p.period_end FROM swe_wealth_plans p LEFT JOIN rm_jkh_user_info u ON p.sap_id COLLATE utf8mb4_bin = u.user_id WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.source_label IN ('我的关注', '分行中台', '行长关注') AND p.id IN #{id}

SELECT DISTINCT plan_id, sence_id AS skill_id, execute_day AS execution_day FROM swe_plan_sence_cron WHERE execute_day >= #{query.startDate} AND execute_day <= #{query.endDate} AND
(plan_id = #{r.planId} AND sence_id = #{r.skillId})

SELECT DISTINCT k.skill_id, c.name AS category_name FROM swe_marketplace_skills k LEFT JOIN swe_marketplace_categories c ON c.id = k.category_id AND c.source_id = k.source_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci WHERE k.source_id = 'RMASSIST' AND k.skill_id IN #{id}

SELECT DISTINCT s.plan_id, j.tenant_id AS sap_id, s.scene_id AS skill_id, k.skill_name, j.id AS job_id FROM swe_wealth_plan_scenes s JOIN swe_marketplace_skills k ON k.skill_id = s.scene_id AND k.source_id = 'RMASSIST' JOIN swe_cron_jobs j ON j.plan_id = s.plan_id AND j.skill_ids = s.scene_id AND j.source_id = 'RMASSIST' AND j.status != 'deleted' WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND
(s.plan_id = #{r.planId} AND j.tenant_id = #{r.sapId})
AND
(s.plan_id = #{r.planId} AND s.scene_id = #{r.skillId})
AND s.scene_id IN #{skill}

SELECT DISTINCT e.job_id, e.trace_id, e.actual_time, e.status, e.is_read AS `read` FROM swe_cron_executions e JOIN swe_plan_sence_cron c ON e.actual_time >= CAST(c.execute_day AS DATE) AND e.actual_time < DATE_ADD(CAST(c.execute_day AS DATE), INTERVAL 1 DAY) WHERE c.execute_day >= #{query.startDate} AND c.execute_day <= #{query.endDate} AND
(e.job_id = #{r.jobId} AND c.plan_id = #{r.planId} AND c.sence_id = #{r.skillId} AND e.actual_time >= #{r.createdAt})

SELECT job_id, trace_id, actual_time, status, is_read AS `read` FROM swe_cron_executions WHERE
(trace_id = #{r.traceId} AND job_id = #{r.jobId} AND actual_time >= DATE(#{r.actualTime}) AND actual_time < DATE_ADD(DATE(#{r.actualTime}), INTERVAL 1 DAY))

SELECT DISTINCT job_id, skill_id, trace_id, custuid AS customer_id FROM swe_cron_result_index WHERE result_type = 'plan' AND is_latest_success = 1 AND status = 'SUC' AND
(job_id = #{r.relation.jobId} AND skill_id = #{r.relation.skillId} AND trace_id = #{r.traceId})

SELECT DISTINCT d.cust_uid AS customer_id FROM swe_html_preview_click_events c JOIN swe_skill_contact_detail d ON d.click_id = c.id WHERE (c.event_type = 'button_click' OR (c.event_type = 'preview_view' AND c.template_type = 'sub')) AND d.cust_uid IS NOT NULL AND
(c.trace_id = #{r.execution.traceId} AND c.customer_id = #{r.customerId} AND c.clicked_at >= #{r.execution.executionDay} AND c.clicked_at < DATE_ADD(#{r.execution.executionDay}, INTERVAL 1 DAY))

SELECT DISTINCT c.trace_id, c.customer_id, DATE(c.clicked_at) AS execution_day, CASE WHEN c.event_type = 'button_click' THEN c.button_type ELSE NULL END AS button_type, d.cust_uid AS contact_customer_id FROM swe_html_preview_click_events c LEFT JOIN swe_skill_contact_detail d ON d.click_id = c.id WHERE (c.event_type = 'button_click' OR (c.event_type = 'preview_view' AND c.template_type = 'sub')) AND
(c.trace_id = #{r.execution.traceId} AND c.customer_id = #{r.customerId} AND c.clicked_at >= #{r.execution.executionDay} AND c.clicked_at < DATE_ADD(#{r.execution.executionDay}, INTERVAL 1 DAY))

, task_rows AS ( SELECT DISTINCT s.sap_id, s.plan_id, s.skill_id, s.execution_day, s.job_id, CASE WHEN e.job_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS executed, CASE WHEN e.job_id IS NOT NULL AND (e.status IS NULL OR BINARY e.status != 'success') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS failed FROM scheduled s LEFT JOIN selected e ON e.job_id = s.job_id AND e.execution_day = s.execution_day ), task_stats AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS scheduled_task_count, COALESCE(SUM(executed), 0) AS executed_task_count, COALESCE(SUM(1 - executed), 0) AS pending_task_count, COALESCE(SUM(failed), 0) AS failed_task_count FROM task_rows ), base_stats AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT plan_id) AS plan_count, COUNT(DISTINCT skill_id) AS skill_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sap_id) AS user_count FROM executed ), branch_rows AS ( SELECT DISTINCT bbk_id, org_id FROM executed ), branch_stats AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS covered_sub_branch_count FROM branch_rows ), skill_users AS ( SELECT DISTINCT skill_id, skill_name, sap_id FROM executed ), top_skill AS ( SELECT skill_id, MIN(skill_name) AS skill_name, COUNT(DISTINCT sap_id) AS user_count FROM skill_users GROUP BY skill_id ORDER BY user_count DESC, skill_id ASC LIMIT 1 ), recommendations AS ( SELECT DISTINCT e.job_id, e.skill_id, e.trace_id, e.execution_day, e.is_read, CAST(r.custuid AS BINARY) AS custuid FROM executed e INNER JOIN swe_cron_result_index r ON r.job_id = e.job_id AND r.skill_id = e.skill_id AND r.trace_id = e.trace_id AND r.result_type = 'plan' AND r.is_latest_success = 1 AND r.status = 'SUC' ), plan_rows AS ( SELECT DISTINCT trace_id, custuid FROM recommendations WHERE custuid != '' ), plan_stats AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS task_count FROM plan_rows ), customer_stats AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN custuid != '' THEN custuid END) AS recommended_customer_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN custuid != '' AND is_read = 1 THEN custuid END) AS viewed_customer_count FROM recommendations ), contact_stats AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(d.cust_uid AS BINARY)) AS contacted_customer_count FROM recommendations r INNER JOIN swe_html_preview_click_events c ON c.trace_id = r.trace_id AND c.customer_id = r.custuid AND c.clicked_at >= r.execution_day AND c.clicked_at < DATE_ADD(r.execution_day, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND (c.event_type = 'button_click' OR (c.event_type = 'preview_view' AND c.template_type = 'sub')) INNER JOIN swe_skill_contact_detail d ON d.click_id = c.id ) SELECT b.plan_count, b.skill_count, p.task_count, t.scheduled_task_count, t.executed_task_count, t.pending_task_count, t.failed_task_count, c.recommended_customer_count, c.viewed_customer_count, a.contacted_customer_count, b.user_count, o.covered_sub_branch_count, CONVERT(k.skill_id USING utf8mb4) AS most_used_skill_id, k.skill_name AS most_used_skill_name, COALESCE(k.user_count, 0) AS most_used_skill_user_count FROM base_stats b INNER JOIN task_stats t ON 1 = 1 INNER JOIN branch_stats o ON 1 = 1 INNER JOIN plan_stats p ON 1 = 1 INNER JOIN customer_stats c ON 1 = 1 INNER JOIN contact_stats a ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN top_skill k ON 1 = 1
mapper.sql: , group_scheduled AS ( SELECT r.bbk_id, r.org_id, r.sap_id, r.plan_id, r.skill_id, r.skill_name, r.job_id, r.execution_day, r.bbk_name, r.org_name, r.user_name, r.level, r.source_label, CAST(r.execution_day AS BINARY) r.bbk_id r.sap_id r.skill_id r.plan_id CAST('TOTAL' AS BINARY) AS group_key, r.org_id r.skill_id CAST('' AS BINARY) AS second_key FROM executedscheduled r ), group_executed AS ( SELECT r.bbk_id, r.org_id, r.sap_id, r.plan_id, r.skill_id, r.skill_name, r.job_id, r.execution_day, r.bbk_name, r.org_name, r.user_name, r.level, r.source_label, r.trace_id, r.is_read, CAST(r.execution_day AS BINARY) r.bbk_id r.sap_id r.skill_id r.plan_id CAST('TOTAL' AS BINARY) AS group_key, r.org_id r.skill_id CAST('' AS BINARY) AS second_key FROM executed r )
mapper.select: , report_groups AS ( SELECT group_key, second_key, MIN(bbk_id) AS bbk_id, MIN(bbk_name) AS bbk_name, MIN(org_id) AS org_id, MIN(org_name) AS org_name, MIN(sap_id) AS sap_id, MIN(user_name) AS user_name, MIN(level) AS level, MIN(plan_id) AS plan_id, MIN(skill_id) AS skill_id, MIN(skill_name) AS skill_name, MIN(execution_day) AS execution_day, COUNT(DISTINCT sap_id) AS assigned_manager_count FROM group_scheduled GROUP BY group_key, second_key ), task_rows AS ( SELECT DISTINCT s.group_key, s.second_key, s.sap_id, s.plan_id, s.skill_id, s.execution_day, s.job_id, CASE WHEN e.job_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS executed, CASE WHEN e.job_id IS NOT NULL AND (e.status IS NULL OR BINARY e.status != 'success') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS failed FROM group_scheduled s LEFT JOIN selected e ON e.job_id = s.job_id AND e.execution_day = s.execution_day ), task_stats AS ( SELECT group_key, second_key, COUNT(*) AS scheduled_task_count, SUM(executed) AS executed_task_count, SUM(1 - executed) AS pending_task_count, SUM(failed) AS failed_task_count FROM task_rows GROUP BY group_key, second_key ), base_stats AS ( SELECT group_key, second_key, COUNT(DISTINCT plan_id) AS plan_count, COUNT(DISTINCT skill_id) AS skill_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sap_id) AS user_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_read = 1 THEN sap_id END) AS participant_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN source_label = '我的关注' THEN plan_id END) AS my_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN source_label = '分行中台' THEN plan_id END) AS branch_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN source_label = '行长关注' THEN plan_id END) AS president_count FROM group_executed GROUP BY group_key, second_key ), source_stats AS ( SELECT group_key, second_key, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN source_label = '我的关注' THEN plan_id END) AS my_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN source_label = '分行中台' THEN plan_id END) AS branch_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN source_label = '行长关注' THEN plan_id END) AS president_count FROM group_scheduled GROUP BY group_key, second_key ), branch_rows AS ( SELECT DISTINCT group_key, second_key, bbk_id, org_id FROM group_executed ), branch_stats AS ( SELECT group_key, second_key, COUNT(*) AS covered_sub_branch_count FROM branch_rows GROUP BY group_key, second_key ), recommendations AS ( SELECT DISTINCT e.group_key, e.second_key, e.trace_id, e.execution_day, e.is_read, CAST(r.custuid AS BINARY) AS custuid FROM group_executed e INNER JOIN swe_cron_result_index r ON r.job_id = e.job_id AND r.skill_id = e.skill_id AND r.trace_id = e.trace_id AND 1 = 0 AND r.result_type = 'plan' AND r.is_latest_success = 1 AND r.status = 'SUC' ), plan_rows AS ( SELECT DISTINCT group_key, second_key, trace_id, custuid FROM recommendations WHERE custuid != '' ), plan_stats AS ( SELECT group_key, second_key, COUNT(*) AS task_count FROM plan_rows GROUP BY group_key, second_key ), customer_stats AS ( SELECT group_key, second_key, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN custuid != '' THEN custuid END) AS recommended_customer_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN custuid != '' AND is_read = 1 THEN custuid END) AS viewed_customer_count FROM recommendations GROUP BY group_key, second_key ), action_stats AS ( SELECT r.group_key, r.second_key, COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(d.cust_uid AS BINARY)) AS contacted_customer_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.event_type = 'button_click' AND BINARY c.button_type = 'insight' AND r.custuid != '' THEN r.custuid END) AS insight_customer_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.event_type = 'button_click' AND BINARY c.button_type = 'phone' AND r.custuid != '' THEN r.custuid END) AS call_customer_count FROM recommendations r INNER JOIN swe_html_preview_click_events c ON c.trace_id = r.trace_id AND 1 = 0 AND c.customer_id = r.custuid AND c.clicked_at >= r.execution_day AND c.clicked_at < DATE_ADD(r.execution_day, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND (c.event_type = 'button_click' OR (c.event_type = 'preview_view' AND c.template_type = 'sub')) LEFT JOIN swe_skill_contact_detail d ON d.click_id = c.id GROUP BY r.group_key, r.second_key ) SELECT CONVERT(g.group_key USING utf8mb4) AS `key`, CONVERT(g.second_key USING utf8mb4) AS second_key, CONVERT(g.bbk_id USING utf8mb4) AS bbk_id, g.bbk_name, CONVERT(g.org_id USING utf8mb4) AS org_id, g.org_name, CONVERT(g.sap_id USING utf8mb4) AS sap_id, g.user_name, g.level, CONVERT(g.plan_id USING utf8mb4) AS plan_id, CONVERT(g.skill_id USING utf8mb4) AS skill_id, g.skill_name, g.execution_day AS day, g.assigned_manager_count, COALESCE(b.plan_count, 0) AS plan_count, COALESCE(b.skill_count, 0) AS skill_count, COALESCE(b.user_count, 0) AS user_count, COALESCE(b.participant_count, 0) AS participant_count, COALESCE(z.my_count, 0) AS my_count, COALESCE(z.branch_count, 0) AS branch_count, COALESCE(z.president_count, 0) AS president_count, COALESCE(o.covered_sub_branch_count, 0) AS covered_sub_branch_count, t.scheduled_task_count, t.executed_task_count, t.pending_task_count, t.failed_task_count, COALESCE(p.task_count, 0) AS task_count, COALESCE(c.recommended_customer_count, 0) AS recommended_customer_count, COALESCE(c.viewed_customer_count, 0) AS viewed_customer_count, COALESCE(a.contacted_customer_count, 0) AS contacted_customer_count, COALESCE(a.insight_customer_count, 0) AS insight_customer_count, COALESCE(a.call_customer_count, 0) AS call_customer_count FROM report_groups g INNER JOIN task_stats t ON g.group_key <=> t.group_key AND g.second_key <=> t.second_key LEFT JOIN source_stats z ON g.group_key <=> z.group_key AND g.second_key <=> z.second_key LEFT JOIN base_stats b ON g.group_key <=> b.group_key AND g.second_key <=> b.second_key LEFT JOIN branch_stats o ON g.group_key <=> o.group_key AND g.second_key <=> o.second_key LEFT JOIN plan_stats p ON g.group_key <=> p.group_key AND g.second_key <=> p.second_key LEFT JOIN customer_stats c ON g.group_key <=> c.group_key AND g.second_key <=> c.second_key LEFT JOIN action_stats a ON g.group_key <=> a.group_key AND g.second_key <=> a.second_key ORDER BY g.group_key, g.second_key

SELECT CONVERT(group_key USING utf8mb4) AS `key`, CONVERT(second_key USING utf8mb4) AS second_key, CONVERT(MIN(skill_id) USING utf8mb4) AS skill_id, MIN(skill_name) AS skill_name, MIN(bbk_name) AS bbk_name, MIN(org_name) AS org_name FROM group_scheduled GROUP BY group_key, second_key ORDER BY group_key, second_key

, assigned AS ( SELECT skill_id, MIN(skill_name) AS skill_name, COUNT(DISTINCT sap_id) AS assigned_manager_count FROM scheduled GROUP BY skill_id ), participants AS ( SELECT skill_id, COUNT(DISTINCT sap_id) AS participant_count FROM executed WHERE is_read = 1 GROUP BY skill_id ) SELECT CONVERT(a.skill_id USING utf8mb4) AS `key`, CONVERT(a.skill_id USING utf8mb4) AS skill_id, a.skill_name, a.assigned_manager_count, COALESCE(p.participant_count, 0) AS participant_count FROM assigned a LEFT JOIN participants p ON p.skill_id = a.skill_id ORDER BY a.skill_id
